description: Foots and cross-foots declared financial statement lines and ties declared note amounts to declared statement lines, in integer minor units, under the tolerance and sign convention the caller declares. The caller declares the columns, the lines (an id, a section id, a role of detail, subtotal or total, and one amount per column), the total relations (a total line and the signed lines it sums), the cross-foot relations (a line whose total column equals the sum of declared columns) and the note references (a note id, the noted amount and the line and column it should tie to). Returns every footing break (column, expected sum, stated total, difference), every cross-foot break, every note-to-statement break, the lines no relation references, and a verdict of ties, breaks, indeterminate when a referenced id or a required declaration is missing, or input_refused. A difference at or inside the tolerance ties; one minor unit past it is a break. Ids and integers only: free-text labels, names and anything shaped like an account number are refused with an explicit code and never read. Checks arithmetic and references among declared values. It does not read a document, does not verify that the figures are the real ones, and is not an audit procedure on its own. It is distinct from art-526, which ties a reported figure to a general ledger figure by account, and from the domain-specific art-508 and art-509; this node checks a statement against itself and against its own note references. No adjacency is declared here.
deferred_reason: New gpu:false node, art-839-statement-footing-crossfoot, authored 2026-11-13. No GPU prove has been run and none is proposed by this row: deferred per the section 18 steady-state rule (RIDER-KERNEL.md). Work is bounded integer addition over at most 200 lines, 8 columns and 200 relations; an exec-only cycle measure comes before any booking, and a measure above 30M cycles stops there.
